wargear.name: Strategos slate
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A cogitator slate loaded with the Codex's battle-plans and the day's terrain surveys. The model gains +1 Cool and +1 Intelligence.

wargear.name: Praetorian hoplon
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tall tower shield blazoned with the Ultramar omega. Every model in the unit has a 4+ Invulnerable Save if it was worse.

wargear.name: Ultramar fire-control array
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Range-finders and a dedicated gunnery cogitator, run to Ultramar tolerances. The vehicle gains +1 Ballistic Skill.

wargear.name: Standard of Macragge
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A tall eagle standard of Ultramar. Gives the unit Rally to the Eagle.

wargear.name: Fleet-linked vox-array
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A vox-array tied to the fleet net. Gives the model Orchestrated Advance.

wargear.name: Oath-scroll of Macragge
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A scroll of oaths sealed in wax. The bearer gains +1 Cool and Macragge Oath.

wargear.name: Bulwark plates
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Heavy shield-plates that lock together into a wall. Gives the unit Bulwark Stance.

wargear.name: Gyro-stabiliser
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A turret ring stabilised by a gyro-mass. Gives the vehicle Gyro-Lock.

wargear.name: Ablative bulwark
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. Cladding that breaks up long-range hits. Gives the vehicle Bulwark Cladding.

wargear.name: Faithful spirit core
wargear.text: Legacy house rule. A machine spirit steeped in the Codex. Gives the vehicle Dutiful Spirit.

option.text: The Sergeant may take an Ultramar pattern weapon
Up to three Legionaries may exchange their bolter for
The unit may carry Praetorian hoplons
May be fitted with an Ultramar fire-control array
The Strike Leader may exchange the Argean power sword for
The unit may carry a Standard of Macragge
Praetor's Regalia: may take up to two relics
The Sergeant may order Bulwark plates for the unit
May take an Ultramar vehicle fitting
Up to two models may carry a Phalanx lance
One model may carry a Pilum launcher

modifiers.text: Drilled to the Codex: +1 LD, -1 I.
Eagles of the storm: +1 WS, -1 T.
Standard of Macragge: Rally to the Eagle.
Oath-scroll of Macragge: +1 CL, Macragge Oath.

rules.name: Drilled Cohorts
rules.text: Legacy house rule (The Five Hundred Muster). A unit with this rule adds +1 to its Cool for Checks to avoid gaining Tactical Statuses. If a friendly Centurion is within 6", it also passes Morale Checks automatically.

rules.name: Shield Wall
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Phalanx of the Invictus). A unit with this rule gains Feel No Pain (6+) against Shooting Attacks, as long as it did not Rush in its previous Movement phase.

rules.name: Eagle Strike
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Strike of the Locutarus). A unit with this rule gains Deep Strike. The turn it arrives by Deep Strike it may Rush as normal but may not Charge.

rules.name: Vengeance of Calth
rules.text: Legacy house rule (Remember Calth). While an enemy Word Bearers unit is within 12" of a model with this rule, friendly Ultramarines units within 12" of that model pass Morale Checks automatically and add +1 to their Charge rolls against Word Bearers units.

rules.name: Rally to the Eagle
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, at the start of its controller's turn, a unit with this rule and every friendly Ultramarines unit within 6" removes all Tactical Statuses.

rules.name: Orchestrated Advance
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, a friendly Ultramarines unit held in Reserves that is within 12" of this model on arrival counts as having passed its Reserves arrival without the usual risk of Mishap.

rules.name: Macragge Oath
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While in a Challenge, a model with this rule may not be forced to decline, and its Cool is +1 for Checks to avoid Tactical Statuses.

rules.name: Bulwark Stance
rules.text: Legacy house rule. While a unit with this rule has not moved, add +1 to its Cover Saves against Shooting Attacks.

rules.name: Gyro-Lock
rules.text: Legacy house rule. A vehicle with this rule that moved this turn does not suffer penalties to Hit for moving.

rules.name: Bulwark Cladding
rules.text: Legacy house rule. The AP of Shooting Attacks against a vehicle with this rule is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 6, if the shooter is more than 18" away.

rules.name: Dutiful Spirit
rules.text: Legacy house rule. Once per battle, a vehicle with this rule ignores one Crew result that would otherwise affect it.

rites.name: The Five Hundred Muster
rites.flavor: Every world of Ultramar sends its sons, and every son has drilled the same manoeuvres since boyhood.
benefits: Veteran Tactical Squads and Praetorian Breacher Squads may fill Troops slots.
Tactical Squads and Veteran Tactical Squads gain Drilled Cohorts: +1 Cool to avoid Tactical Statuses, and automatic Morale passes near a friendly Centurion.
limitations: At least two Tactical Squads and a Centurion are required.
No Fast Attack units and no model with the Antigrav type.

modifiers.text: The Five Hundred Muster: Drilled Cohorts.

require.note: Bring at least two Tactical Squads.
A Centurion must lead the Muster.

rites.name: Phalanx of the Invictus
rites.flavor: Behind the shield-wall of the Suzerains, the rest of the Legion simply refuses to die.
benefits: Invictus Suzerain Squads may fill Troops slots and gain +1 Cool.
They gain Shield Wall: Feel No Pain (6+) against Shooting Attacks if they did not Rush in their previous Movement phase.
limitations: At least one Invictus Suzerain Squad is required.
No War Engines and no Lord of War units.

modifiers.text: Phalanx of the Invictus: +1 CL, Shield Wall.

require.note: Bring at least one Invictus Suzerain Squad.

rites.name: Strike of the Locutarus
rites.flavor: A line of retros against the clouds, and the Eagles of Macragge are already on the roof.
benefits: Locutarus Storm Squads may fill Troops slots.
They gain +1 Initiative and Eagle Strike: Deep Strike (they may Rush, but not Charge, on the turn they arrive).
limitations: Locutarus Storm Squads must start the battle in Reserve.
At least one Locutarus Storm Squad is required.
No Armour units and no War Engines.

modifiers.text: Strike of the Locutarus: +1 I, -1 LD, Eagle Strike.

require.note: Bring at least one Locutarus Storm Squad.

rites.name: Remember Calth
rites.flavor: The Legion was shot in the back by its own brothers, and has not yet finished answering.
benefits: Every Ultramarines unit gains Hatred (Word Bearers) and +1 Leadership.

Remus Ventanus and the Honoured Telemechrus gain Vengeance of Calth: nearby friendly units pass Morale Checks automatically and add +1 to Charge rolls against Word Bearers while an enemy Word Bearers unit is within 12".
limitations: Remus Ventanus must lead the army.
No Assassins and no Malefic models.

require.note: Remus Ventanus must lead the army.

armyRules.name: Volley Discipline
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Volley by the numbers. A unit with this rule that has not moved this turn adds +1 to the Hit Tests of its Shooting Attacks. A unit that Rushed this turn suffers -1 to Hit with its Shooting Attacks until the end of the turn.

armyRules.name: Strategos Gambit
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. A plan laid out three moves in advance. Once per battle, at the start of the Movement phase, one friendly Ultramarines unit within 12" of a model with this rule may make a free move of up to 3" before any other unit moves. The model may not Rush in the turn this is used.

armyRules.name: Shield-and-Spear
armyRules.text: Legacy house rule. Tank and infantry fight as one body. A vehicle with this rule adds +1 to its Hit Tests while a friendly Ultramarines Infantry unit is within 6". If there is no such unit within 12", it suffers -1 Ballistic Skill instead.
